targetText: It is the most ardent wish of the author that this book should soon be transformed from a weapon against imperialism into an historic document relegated to the archives.
summary: Written as a theoretical weapon against world imperialism, Bukharin looks forward to the complete overthrow of capitalism.
explanation: Writing immediately after the Bolshevik seizure of power in November 1917, Bukharin connects theoretical economic analysis directly to the practical revolutionary struggle to abolish imperialism.
